description_en: Deletes a specified product category by product category ID
description_zh: 按产品类别 ID 删除指定的产品类别
name: DeleteProductCategory

parameters.help_en: The product category ID. Specifies the product category to delete. You can obtain this ID from the categoryId parameter in the response of CreateProductCategory. GetProductCategory, UpdateProductCategory, and DeleteProductCategory use the same /himarket/v1/product-categories/{categoryId} path to identify a product category. On the product resource side, this parameter corresponds to the Category ID member of Categories (Product categories). Note: This parameter is a path parameter and is required. If it is not specified, the request URL cannot be constructed
parameters.help_zh: 产品类别 ID，指定要删除的产品类别。可由 CreateProductCategory 响应的 categoryId 获得，与 GetProductCategory、UpdateProductCategory、DeleteProductCategory 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/product-categories/{categoryId} 路径来定位产品类别；在产品资源侧对应 Categories「Product分类」的成员「类别ID」。注意：本参数为路径参数，实际为必填项，缺省将无法构造请求 URL
